title: My Favorite By Far!
text: This is my favorite beauty box hands down. For $15 a month I get to try products that Allure's editors and staff all loved when they tested them, so they pass them on to us. Every month theres at least 3 products that work great for me. I am all set with my favorite & regular eyeshadows, eyeliners, mascaras, blushes, etc, and now Allure is introducing me to some wonderful skin and body care products. My face never looked so glowing! Primers, treatment oils, serums, eye creams.... this is my favorite beauty box by far!!
label: positive
